name: University of Auckland
notes: Undergraduate degree entry is 6.0 with no band below 5.5; postgraduate is 6.5 with no band below 6.0. Some programmes sit higher. Results are valid two years and the requirement must be met on one test certificate.

name: Victoria University of Wellington
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is 6.0 with no band below 5.5; standard postgraduate is 6.5 with no band below 6.0. Several named programmes (Education, Linguistics, TESOL) publish higher figures — check the programme page.

name: University of Canterbury
notes: Standard undergraduate entry is an average of 6.0 with a minimum of 5.5 in each of reading, writing, listening and speaking. Postgraduate figures vary sharply by programme (7.0 with 6.5 in each band for many taught programmes) and are not consolidated here.

name: Massey University
notes: Set out in the university's English language competency regulations: 6.0 with no band below 5.5 for undergraduate programmes, 6.5 with no band below 6.0 for postgraduate. Named professional programmes (Specialist Teaching, Planning) ask for more.

name: University of Waikato
notes: Undergraduate and graduate certificates/diplomas ask for 6.0 with no band below 5.5. Postgraduate programmes ask for 6.5 with no band below 6.0. Initial Teacher Education is far higher: 7.0 with no band below 7.0.
